basic.name: Votive Incense
basic.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Lingsha's ATK to a single target enemy.

skill.name: Smoke and Splendor
skill.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies and at the same time, restores HP equal to {{scaling2}}% of Lingsha's ATK plus {{scaling3}} for all allies. Fuyuan's action advances by 20%.

ultimate.name: Dripping Mistscape
ultimate.description_template: Inflicts "Befog" on all enemies. While in "Befog," targets receive {{scaling1}}% increased Break DMG, lasting for 2 turn(s). Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies, and at the same time restores HP equal to {{scaling3}}% of Lingsha's ATK plus {{scaling4}} for all allies. Fuyuan's action advances by 100%.

talent.name: Mistdance Manifest
talent.description_template: When using Skill, summons Fuyuan, with an initial SPD of 90 and an initial action count of 3. When taking action, Fuyuan launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies. Additionally deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Lingsha's ATK to a single random enemy, and this DMG prioritizes targets that have both Toughness greater than 0 and Fire Weakness. Dispels 1 debuff(s) from all allies and restores HP equal to {{scaling3}}% of Lingsha's ATK plus {{scaling4}}. Fuyuan's action count can accumulate up to 5. When the action count reaches 0 or when Lingsha is knocked down, Fuyuan disappears. While Fuyuan is on the field, using Skill can increase Fuyuan's action count by 3.

technique.name: Wisps of Aurora
technique.description: After using Technique, immediately summons Fuyuan at the start of the next battle and inflicts "Befog" on all enemies, lasting for 2 turn(s).

4.name: Sylvan Smoke
4.description: When using Basic ATK, additionally regenerates 10 Energy.

2.name: Vermilion Waft
2.description: Increases this unit's ATK or Outgoing Healing by an amount equal to 25%/10% of Break Effect, up to a maximum increase of 50%/20% respectively.

6.name: Ember's Echo
6.description: While "Fuyuan" is on the field and any ally character takes DMG or consumes HP, if a character in the team has their current HP percentage lower than or equal to 60%, "Fuyuan" will immediately launch the Talent's Follow-Up ATK against enemies. This does not consume Fuyuan's action count. This effect can trigger again after 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Bloom on Vileward Bouquet
eidolons.description: Lingsha's Weakness Break Efficiency increases by 50%. When an enemy unit's Weakness is Broken, reduces their DEF by 20%.

eidolons.name: Leisure in Carmine Smokeveil
eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, increases all allies' Break Effect by 40%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Shine of Floral Wick
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Redolence from Canopied Banquet
eidolons.description: When Fuyuan takes action, restores HP equal to 40% of Lingsha's ATK for the ally target whose current HP is the lowest.

eidolons.name: Poise Atop Twists and Turns
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Arcadia Under Deep Seclusion
eidolons.description: While "Fuyuan" is on the field, reduces all enemies' All-Type RES by 20%. When "Fuyuan" attacks, additionally deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to 50% of Lingsha's ATK and 5 Toughness Reduction to one random enemy. This prioritizes targets with both Toughness greater than 0 and Fire Weakness.
